MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 8

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 15
   C. 11
   D. 4

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 18
   D. 36

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

23. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

24. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

25. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

26. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

27. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

28. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73

29. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   D. 15

30. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7
